diagnosis: The proof only needs the hypothesis instantiated with g = f. The resulting nonnegative self-inner-product has zero integral, hence is almost everywhere zero; continuity upgrades this to pointwise equality, and definiteness of the inner product yields f = 0. Reusing IsTestFunction.inner supplies both continuity and integrability with less elaboration.
proof_body:
by
  have h := hg f hf
  rw [integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg] at h
  · rw [Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq] at h
    · funext x
      simpa using congrFun h x
    · exact (hf.inner hf).smooth.continuous
    · exact continuous_const
  · exact fun x => real_inner_self_nonneg'
  · exact (hf.inner hf).integrable
